Don't let yourself fall into this travel agency's trap. They are running their business by betraying their customers. There's no doubt the driver took us to almost all the tourist spots in Mumbai and explained everything, but you will find yourself paying much more than what you agreed on while booking the service with them. Mukesh, the money-minded and cunning owner of this travel agency, will talk to you very nicely and in a positive way from the very beginning so that no doubt creeps into your mind and you avail their services fearlessly, but his real game begins towards the end of your trip. He will keep calling you and say that you booked the service for xyz days, and he thought that it was for fewer than that, and then he will charge you much more than what was finalized at the beginning. My husband had texted him every detail of our itinerary mentioning all the dates and the duration of our trip while booking and finalizing the amount, still at the end of the trip, Mukesh said that he forgot the dates and thought we had booked it for fewer days than we actually used. But we had in fact used it exactly as we had informed him at the very beginning. We literally quarreled with him regarding this, but unfortunately, we had to pay more than what was decided, just because he 'forgot' the duration we booked the service for. It was actually his plan. Maybe this is his way of gaining extra money from the customers. Moreover, the driver also asked for extra money from us, which went into his pocket. We paid the driver's bills for every lunch he had with us during the sightseeing throughout the trip, and also handed him some extra cash in the middle and at the end of the trip, from our own choice but he wasn't happy with that. He demanded extra money from us, which we even gave. Mukesh and the driver, Rajesh, ended our trip on a bad note.

Note: The owner might reply that he couldn't find any booking in my name and the review is fake, but actually, the booking was in my husband's name.
